title: SOC Analyst II
description: Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com. We are building a next-generation Security Operations Center (SOC) designed for the AI-first era. We are moving beyond traditional reactive methods to build an intelligent, automated SOC that leverages deep cloud security expertise to stop advanced threats. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented L2 SOC Analyst to be a core member of our 24/7 operations team. This role is for a hands-on analyst who excels at investigating complex alerts, using automation to accelerate response, and is passionate about cloud security. You will be the primary line of in-depth analysis, working to validate, investigate, and contain threats as they are escalated from L1. Please note: This is a 24/7 operational role. The SOC team works in three rotating shifts (morning, afternoon, and night) to ensure continuous monitoring and response. What You Will Be Doing Incident Triage & Investigation Serve as the primary escalation point for alerts triaged by L1 analysts. Conduct detailed analysis of security alerts from a wide range of sources (SIEM, EDR, CSPM, Cloud-native tools) to validate threats and determine their scope. Investigate security incidents in our enterprise and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), correlating data to build a complete picture of attacker activity. Perform deep-dive analysis of logs, kubernetes containers, and endpoint data to identify indicators of compromise (IOCs). Incident Response & Automation Execute and tune automated response playbooks using our SOAR platform for common security incidents. Perform timely incident response actions, such as isolating compromised hosts, blocking malicious IPs/domains, and disabling compromised accounts. Utilize and modify existing scripts (primarily Python) to assist with automated evidence collection and enrichment. Document all investigation steps, findings, and containment actions in our incident management system. Threat Hunting & Cloud Monitoring Participate in hypothesis based threat hunting campaigns based on new threat intelligence or hypotheses developed by senior analysts. Actively monitor and analyze security logs from cloud-native tools (e.g., AWS GuardDuty, CloudTrail,Cloudflare, Azure,etc.) and kubernetes containers. Assist in tuning detection rules and identifying false positives to help improve the fidelity of our security alerts. Continuous Improvement & Collaboration Escalate complex, high-severity, or unresolved incidents to L3 Analysts and the Incident Response team with detailed handover notes. Contribute to the refinement of SOC documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and investigation runbooks. Provide guidance and mentorship to L1 analysts on triage techniques and alert analysis. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Willingness and ability to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment (morning, afternoon, and night). 4-6 years of experience in a Security Operations (SOC) environment, with demonstrated L2 capabilities. Cloud & Container Security Experience: Hands-on experience monitoring and responding to alerts in at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP); fundamental knowledge on container security Technical Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with SIEM (e.g., CrowdStrike, Splunk, QRadar, Azure Sentinel) and EDR (e.g., CrowdStrike, SentinelOne) platforms. AI/Automation Familiarity: Experience using a SOAR platform and familiarity with AI tools and their practical implementation. Strong working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to incident analysis. Why Join Us Be at the forefront of a modern, cloud-focused Security Operations Center. Gain deep, hands-on experience with cutting-edge cloud security, automation, and threat intelligence technologies. A clear career path for growth into L3, threat hunting, or automation engineering roles. Collaborate with world-class security and engineering leaders in a high-impact, operational role. Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us! Security & Compliance This role requires adherence to Saviynt’s information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training. Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: IAM Quality Analyst
description: Main Accountabilities · Own the QA and testing workstream for IAM CI backlog items, from test planning through production validation and closure. · Review intake requests, business requirements, solution designs, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications to identify test scope, dependencies, risks, and coverage gaps. · Develop and maintain test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, traceability, and execution schedules for functional, integration, regression, security, and negative testing. · Execute SIT and coordinate UAT for IAM changes, integrations, access requests, provisioning and deprovisioning flows, access certifications, role or entitlement changes, and privileged access use cases. · Validate that solutions meet business requirements, IAM control expectations, enterprise security standards, regulatory obligations, and user needs. · Log, prioritise, track, retest, and close defects in JIRA, ensuring clear reproduction steps, expected results, supporting evidence, ownership, and timely escalation. · Coordinate with developers, business analysts, IAM Operations, product owners, application teams, and business testers to resolve issues and keep testing aligned with release timelines. · Provide concise status updates during daily stand-ups, project meetings, defect triage sessions, and release-readiness reviews, highlighting progress, risks, blockers, decisions, and required actions. · Support go-live readiness by confirming test completion, critical-defect closure, evidence availability, stakeholder sign-off, deployment checks, rollback considerations, and operational handover. · Perform post-deployment validation, coordinate production issue triage, and support the transition of delivered solutions to business-as-usual support teams. · Maintain accurate QA documentation, test metrics, dashboards, audit evidence, lessons learned, and reusable regression packs across the assignment. · Promote continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to strengthen test coverage, automate repeatable tests, reduce defects, and improve delivery quality. Skills · Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, QA processes, defect management, risk-based testing, and test evidence requirements. · Practical understanding of IAM concepts, including identity lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver processes, authentication, authorisation, role-based access, access requests, provisioning, deprovisioning, access certification, segregation of duties, and privileged access management. · Hands-on experience testing IAM platforms or access-provisioning solutions; experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ is strongly preferred. · Familiarity with technologies and integrations commonly used in IAM environments, including Active Directory, CyberArk, AWS, Azure, Windows, UNIX/Linux, databases, APIs, file-based feeds, and enterprise applications. · Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to review logs, data extracts, and system behaviour to investigate test failures; knowledge of Java is an advantage. · Experience using JIRA or a comparable test and defect management tool, with disciplined documentation and evidence capture. · Experience working with Agile and Scrum delivery methods and within cross-functional project teams. · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to assess business and security impact. · Effective stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to drive actions, manage dependencies, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. · Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment, prioritising competing tasks and escalating risks or blockers promptly. · Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to produce clear test documentation, status reports, and stakeholder updates. · A proactive, accountable, and delivery-focused approach, with a commitment to quality, security, and continuous improvement. Requirements · Minimum three years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, including test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting. · Minimum three years of experience supporting IT security, access control, or IAM projects, with demonstrated knowledge of identity governance and administration. · Proven experience supporting end-to-end solution delivery, from intake and requirements review through testing, production deployment, and post-implementation support. · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. · Relevant certifications in software testing, IAM, SailPoint, CyberArk, cloud security, or information security are an advantage. · Availability to collaborate with stakeholders during Eastern Time business hours, as required by the project. Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per month Benefits: Health insurance Provident Fund Application Question(s): What is your current CTC & Notice period? Experience: IAM Test Analysis: 5 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Associate Security Operations Analyst
description: About Trellix Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com. Role Overview: The SOC Cloud Security Operations Analyst (Tier II) serves as an escalation point within the Security Operations Center (SOC) and overall Fusion Center. This role is responsible for monitoring, investigating, and remediating complex security alerts, conducting detailed technical analysis, and collaborating across different environments to mitigate threats. The ideal candidate pairs traditional SOC triage expertise with modern working knowledge of Security AI/ML tools and deep hands-on expertise in multi-cloud infrastructure security across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) About the Role : Incident Investigation & Escalation: Take full ownership of security incidents; validate findings, determine scope and impact, execute remediation, and drive root cause analysis. Multi-Cloud Security Operations: Monitor, investigate, and contain threats across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), utilizing native cloud security controls and centralized cloud security telemetry. AI-Enabled Threat Analysis: Leverage AI/ML-driven threat detection platforms, automated investigation tools, and LLM-assisted workflows to accelerate threat hunting, alert summarization, and query generation. Forensics & Malware Analysis: Perform technical triage, dynamic malware analysis, memory/artifact collection, and detailed log analysis across endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry. Vulnerability & Threat Management: Work in concert with Security Engineering and Product Security to prioritize and remediate active exploits, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities. Global Handoffs & Mentorship: Lead seamless shift handoffs to global counterpart teams and provide ongoing mentoring and knowledge transfer Incident Documentation & Reporting: Author comprehensive incident reports, operational briefs, post-incident reviews, and tickets while ensuring evidence integrity for Incident Response workflows. About You : 1-2 years of direct operational security experience within an enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) or Incident Response team acting as an escalation point (Tier II). Proven track record of handling high-severity incidents across both on-premises and enterprise multi-cloud environments. Cloud Security Infrastructure Expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) AWS Security: Hands-on experience investigating alerts from AWS Security Hub, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and IAM Policy/Permission boundaries. Microsoft Azure Security: Experience with Azure Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Activity Logs, NSGs, and Entra ID (Azure AD) identity threat detection. Google Cloud (GCP) Security: Familiarity with GCP Security Command Center (SCC), Cloud Audit Logs, VPC Firewall rules, and IAM conditional bindings. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Security: Working knowledge of OCI Guardrail/Data Safe, OCI Audit Logs, Identity Domains, and OCI Network Security Groups (NSGs). Cloud Detection & Response (CDR): Solid understanding of cloud-native attack vectors (e.g., IAM credential abuse, metadata service exploitation, container escape, storage bucket misconfigurations, cross-cloud lateral movement). Artificial Intelligence & Operational AI Knowledge Working-Level Security AI Skills: Practical experience utilizing AI/ML-driven security tools (e.g., Security Copilot, AI-assisted EDR/SIEM features, automated triage playbooks). Prompt Engineering & Tooling: Ability to write effective natural language prompts to query security telemetry, generate KQL/SPL search strings, summarize complex threat reports, or analyze malicious scripts/code snippets. AI Risk Awareness: Basic understanding of security risks unique to AI integration (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage via LLMs, adversarial machine learning concepts). Core SOC & Technical Competencies Endpoint & Malware Analysis: Hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR technology stacks (e.g., McAfee/Trellix, CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint) and dynamic malware analysis techniques. Network & OS Fundamentals: Deep technical understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP, routing, and deep OS internals across Windows, Linux/Unix, and macOS. SIEM & Log Analysis: Expertise in querying and correlating enterprise SIEM telemetry, identifying pattern anomalies, and reducing false positives. Incident Handling Procedures: Demonstrated success executing NIST SP 800-61 / MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping during active containment and recovery phases. Soft Skills & Professional Attributes High-Pressure Execution: Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple high-priority incidents under tight timelines. Strong Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; adept at presenting complex technical findings to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders. Global Team Alignment: High initiative with a collaborative style suitable for cross-functional and globally distributed teams. Company Benefits and Perks: We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees. Retirement Plans Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage Paid Time Off Paid Parental Leave Support for Community Involvement We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status. Our Commitment to You: At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications. Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process. Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process. If you have questions or believe you may have encountered fraudulent activity related to Trellix recruiting, please contact us at ethics@trellix.com . description: Job Title: Senior Security Operations Analyst About Trellix Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Role Overview: The SOC Cloud Security Operations Analyst serves as an escalation point within the Security Operations Center (SOC) and overall Fusion Center. This role is responsible for monitoring, investigating, and remediating complex security alerts, conducting detailed technical analysis, and collaborating across different environments to mitigate threats. The ideal candidate pairs traditional SOC triage expertise with modern working knowledge of Security AI/ML tools and deep hands-on expertise in multi-cloud infrastructure security across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) About the Role : Incident Investigation & Escalation: Take full ownership of security incidents; validate findings, determine scope and impact, execute remediation, and drive root cause analysis. Multi-Cloud Security Operations: Monitor, investigate, and contain threats across hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI), utilizing native cloud security controls and centralized cloud security telemetry. AI-Enabled Threat Analysis: Leverage AI/ML-driven threat detection platforms, automated investigation tools, and LLM-assisted workflows to accelerate threat hunting, alert summarization, and query generation. Forensics & Malware Analysis: Perform technical triage, dynamic malware analysis, memory/artifact collection, and detailed log analysis across endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry. Vulnerability & Threat Management: Work in concert with Security Engineering and Product Security to prioritize and remediate active exploits, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities. Global Handoffs & Mentorship: Lead seamless shift handoffs to global counterpart teams and provide ongoing mentoring and knowledge transfer Incident Documentation & Reporting: Author comprehensive incident reports, operational briefs, post-incident reviews, and tickets while ensuring evidence integrity for Incident Response workflows. About You : 4-6 years of direct operational security experience within an enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC) or Incident Response team acting as an escalation point (Tier II). Proven track record of handling high-severity incidents across both on-premises and enterprise multi-cloud environments. Cloud Security Infrastructure Expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) AWS Security: Hands-on experience investigating alerts from AWS Security Hub, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and IAM Policy/Permission boundaries. Microsoft Azure Security: Experience with Azure Sentinel, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Activity Logs, NSGs, and Entra ID (Azure AD) identity threat detection. Google Cloud (GCP) Security: Familiarity with GCP Security Command Center (SCC), Cloud Audit Logs, VPC Firewall rules, and IAM conditional bindings. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Security: Working knowledge of OCI Guardrail/Data Safe, OCI Audit Logs, Identity Domains, and OCI Network Security Groups (NSGs). Cloud Detection & Response (CDR): Solid understanding of cloud-native attack vectors (e.g., IAM credential abuse, metadata service exploitation, container escape, storage bucket misconfigurations, cross-cloud lateral movement). Artificial Intelligence & Operational AI Knowledge Working-Level Security AI Skills: Practical experience utilizing AI/ML-driven security tools (e.g., Security Copilot, AI-assisted EDR/SIEM features, automated triage playbooks). Prompt Engineering & Tooling: Ability to write effective natural language prompts to query security telemetry, generate KQL/SPL search strings, summarize complex threat reports, or analyze malicious scripts/code snippets. AI Risk Awareness: Basic understanding of security risks unique to AI integration (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage via LLMs, adversarial machine learning concepts). Core SOC & Technical Competencies Endpoint & Malware Analysis: Hands-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR technology stacks (e.g., McAfee/Trellix, CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint) and dynamic malware analysis techniques. Network & OS Fundamentals: Deep technical understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP, routing, and deep OS internals across Windows, Linux/Unix, and macOS. SIEM & Log Analysis: Expertise in querying and correlating enterprise SIEM telemetry, identifying pattern anomalies, and reducing false positives. Incident Handling Procedures: Demonstrated success executing NIST SP 800-61 / MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping during active containment and recovery phases. Soft Skills & Professional Attributes High-Pressure Execution: Proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple high-priority incidents under tight timelines. Strong Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; adept at presenting complex technical findings to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders. Global Team Alignment: High initiative with a collaborative style suitable for cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
